heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 97–35, title XXI, § 2113(k), Aug. 13, 1981, 95 Stat. 795

notes.text: Section, act Aug. 14, 1935, ch. 531, title XI, § 1171, as added Oct. 25, 1977, Pub. L. 95–142, § 5(d)(2)(D), 91 Stat. 1186, set forth provisions respecting Federal-State relations regarding memorandum of understanding between Organization and State agency.
